title: Minimax Optimality of the NPMLE for Gaussian Mixtures in Hellinger Distance
abstract: arXiv:2610.30109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We analyze the problem of estimating univariate Gaussian mixture densities using the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) based on $n$ independent and identically distributed samples. We show that the unconstrained NPMLE achieves the minimax optimal rate $\log(n)/n$ in squared Hellinger distance, when the true mixing measure is sub-Gaussian. In addition, we show that when the true mixing measure has compact support, the NMPLE constrained to a compact interval also achieves the minimax optimal rate, which is slightly faster and of order $\log(n)/(n \log \log n)$. Our proof consists of sharply characterizing the local Hellinger bracketing entropy of the class of finite Gaussian mixtures. One of our key technical innovations is to sharply bound the $L^2$ bracketing entropy of balls of bounded-degree polynomials, which may be of independent interest. As an application, we establish the regret-optimality of $g$-modeling proced

translated_title: 高斯混合模型中NPMLE在Hellinger距离下的极小极大最优性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了基于n个独立同分布样本、使用非参数极大似然估计量（NPMLE）来估计一元高斯混合密度的问题。我们证明了当真实的混合测度为次高斯时，无约束的NPMLE在平方Hellinger距离下达到了极小极大最优速率log(n)/n。此外，我们还证明了当真实混合测度具有紧支撑时，约束在紧区间上的NPMLE同样达到极小极大最优速率，且该速率略快，为log(n)/(n log log n)阶。我们的证明关键在于精确刻画有限高斯混合类上的局部Hellinger括号熵。我们的一个关键技术创新是对有界次数多项式球的L²括号熵给出了精确上界，这可能具有独立的研究价值。作为应用，我们建立了g-建模方法的遗憾最优性
tldr: 本文证明了基于n个样本的NPMLE在真实混合测度为次高斯时达到平方Hellinger距离下的极小极大最优速率log(n)/n，并在紧支撑情形下达到更快的log(n)/(n log log n)速率，其证明依赖于对有限高斯混合类局部Hellinger括号熵的精确刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the unconstrained NPMLE achieves the minimax optimal rate log(n)/n in squared Hellinger distance for sub-Gaussian mixing measures, and a faster rate of log(n)/(n log log n) for compactly supported mixing measures, via sharply characterizing the local Hellinger bracketing entropy of finite Gaussian mixtures.
